identity.name: FinGPT
identity.one_liner: Open-source financial large language model project for finance sentiment, analysis, and domain adaptation.
identity.short_description: FinGPT is an open-source financial LLM project from AI4Finance Foundation. It focuses on finance-specific language modeling, sentiment analysis, and domain workflows where general LLMs often need adaptation.

positioning.why_it_matters: Finance is one of the clearest domains where generic LLM behavior needs specialized data, evaluation, and governance. FinGPT gives teams an open project to study financial LLM workflows.
best_for: Teams prototyping sentiment or financial text analysis
Builders comparing domain-specific open-source model projects
not_for: Teams looking for financial advice or trading guarantees
Users who need a general-purpose agent framework

seo_article.intro: FinGPT is an open-source financial LLM project from AI4Finance Foundation.
seo_article.what_it_is: It focuses on financial language modeling, sentiment analysis, and finance-specific workflows.
seo_article.why_it_matters: Finance is a high-stakes domain where open methods, evaluation, and data choices matter.
seo_article.how_it_works: Use FinGPT as a research baseline, then validate it on your own finance tasks with strict evaluation and compliance review.

faq.question: Is FinGPT open source?
faq.answer: Yes. The GitHub repository is listed under the MIT license.

faq.question: Can FinGPT provide financial advice?
faq.answer: FinGPT is a research and development project. Any financial use should go through expert review, compliance checks, and domain-specific evaluation.
